text: one more thing also, it makes it a free feature for customization in the game, and it makes it so i can do things for the assassination part of the game really uniquely like chop the body up and hide it, or i can have a tire blow off the side from a car because its just a joint for example.  but yeah i think the customization part alone is huge some people all they like to do is customize a car or their player model that can be just a game itself lol
resolution: Captured in Part 0a: a joint assembled can be severed — the same typed-connector data drives runtime decomposition, so mounts need an attached|detached state plus a break trigger, not a one-way weld bake. Free payoffs recorded: in-game customization, dismemberment/assassination, vehicle part-loss. Logged as a constraint on the gated composition spec so it isn't designed out. User-confirmed.
